# File blocking tags for the archiveblock plugin
# See: https://github.com/iftechfoundation/ifarchive-archiveblock

# This file is generated from the "safety" tags in the Index files.
# Last generated: {{ date|isodate }}

# Each line represents a file or directory which is blocked in the UK.
# A pathname that ends with "/*" tags all the files in that directory.
# A pathname that ends with "/**" tags all the files in that directory *and*
# its subdirectories.

# The next field is separated from the pathname by a tab. The field has
# the form "FLAGS:TAGS". The FLAGS is empty or "u" (meaning "block this
# file in the UK"). The TAGS are a comma-separated list of values;
# see https://ifarchive.org/misc/org-procedures.html.
